title: A pricing procedure with no tests
prompt: VATCALC.rpgle has no tests. Write an RPGUnit test program in a new member VATCALC_T.rpgle: **FREE, one exported procedure per case named test…, covering the ordinary case, the half-cent rounding in both directions, and zero. Use the RPGUnit assertion procedures and set up nothing you do not need.
check: test -f VATCALC_T.rpgle && codeonly VATCALC_T.rpgle | grep -qiE '^\*\*free' && [ $(codeonly VATCALC_T.rpgle | grep -ciE 'dcl-proc +test[a-z0-9_]* +export') -ge 4 ] && codeonly VATCALC_T.rpgle | grep -qiE '(assert|aequal|iequal)' && codeonly VATCALC_T.rpgle | grep -qi 'calcVat' && codeonly VATCALC_T.rpgle | grep -qiE '(-0\.|negative|credit)'
